carousels.name: 6 signs you're on the edge of an NNN relapse

slides.title: 6 signs you're one bad night from [[a p*rn relapse.]]
slides.sub: Halfway is where people get careless. Check yourself.

slides.title: Signs [[1–3]]
items: You're thinking about p*rn more than last week, not less.

slides.title: Signs [[4–6]]
items: You stopped working out or going out.

slides.title: Two or more = [[red alert]].
slides.body: A p*rn relapse isn't a sudden event. It's the end of a slide you didn't stop. Stop it tonight.

carousels.name: Weak men watch p*rn? No. Tired men do.

slides.title: You're not weak for watching p*rn. [[You're running on empty.]]
slides.sub: Exhaustion makes p*rn hard to resist. Fix the tank.

slides.title: Tired = [[impulsive]]
slides.body: When you're exhausted, impulse control drops. Few people relapse on p*rn at 10 AM. Many do at 2 AM.

slides.title: Stress [[drains]] you
slides.body:
A hard day empties your willpower before evening.

By night, p*rn feels like the only easy thing left.

slides.title: Fill the [[tank]]
slides.body: Sleep, food, movement, real breaks. A rested man says no to p*rn far more easily than a drained one.

slides.title: Refuel [[daily]]
items: Eat real meals, not snacks at midnight.

slides.title: About [[1 in 8]] web searches were for p*rn-type content.
slides.sub: That's why quitting feels like swimming against the internet.

slides.title: Of all [[searches]]
slides.body: An analysis of ~400 million web searches found about 13% were for erotic content (Ogas & Gaddam, A Billion Wicked Thoughts, 2011).

slides.title: It's [[everywhere]]
slides.body: Search bars, feeds, ads, suggested videos. P*rn isn't hiding. You have to build your own walls.

slides.title: It's [[not]] just you
slides.body: If the whole internet leans this way, struggling with p*rn isn't a personal defect. But fighting back is still your job.

carousels.name: What to do in the first 5 minutes after waking up

slides.title: Your first 5 minutes awake decide [[whether p*rn gets your morning.]]
slides.sub: Minute by minute. Save it for tomorrow.

slides.title: Feet on the [[floor]]
slides.body: Don't reach for your phone. Don't lie there scrolling. Lying in bed with your phone is how morning p*rn starts.

slides.title: Light and [[water]]
slides.body:
Open the curtains. Drink a glass of water.

Wake your body up before your phone wakes your cravings.

slides.title: [[Move]]
slides.body: 20 push-ups, a stretch, a quick walk. Movement shifts your state fast.

slides.title: One [[intention]]
slides.body:
"Today I will ___ instead of p*rn."

Then — and only then — pick up your phone.
